title: codec.rs: use .expect() instead of .unwrap() for infallible try_into
description:
Multiple locations use `.try_into().unwrap()` on slice-to-array conversions that are known to be infallible (the slice lengths are guaranteed). Use `.expect("message")` to document the invariant and improve debuggability.

Example at line 405-406:
```rust
let src_iid = u64::from_be_bytes(src[8..16].try_into().unwrap());
let dst_iid = u64::from_be_bytes(dst[8..16].try_into().unwrap());
```

Should be:
```rust
let src_iid = u64::from_be_bytes(src[8..16].try_into().expect("src IID slice is 8 bytes"));
```

Affected lines: 405, 406, 415, 416, 474, 475, 511, 521, 522, 558, 567, 568, 569, 632, 633, 639, 640

File: `rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs`
close_reason: Applied fixes: buf.fill(0), .expect() on infallible try_into, renamed finalize to ones_complement_sum. cargo check and cargo test pass.
